label: BrcWGS21 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a gcuWGS21/BrcWGS21 bacteriophage-resistance integron cassette that supports growth during bacteriophage challenge.
observations: BrcWGS21 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual BrcWGS21 proteins, brcWGS21 nucleotide sequences, attC sites, source database rows naming one gcuWGS21 model, absent DefenseFinder HMM/rules profiles, broad BRiC families, and other mobile integron phage-defense cassettes.
